THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE THESE FACTS ARE AUTHORED: landed slices + their landing SHAs, the SCHEMA version, the next slice, the remaining ladder, AC status, and the ruled/unruled decision set. WHY: before this file, that state was narrated across a 5-12 file write-side fan-out (the master release plan, the STATUS board, the plan, the Steward hand-off, the ledgers) with NOTHING checking that the copies agreed - one reconciliation commit (b70629e5) had to touch 7 files, and the live board is ~79 KB, too large to read whole. HOW IT IS ENFORCED: `generated_views` below names the marker-delimited regions that are RENDERED from this file by scripts/check-release-state-views.sh. That script regenerates each region into a temp buffer and diffs it against what is in the document; any difference is a HARD failure, so a hand-edit of a view, or a change here without a regenerate, both go red. Regenerate with `scripts/check-release-state-views.sh --write`. TO CHANGE A FACT: edit it HERE, then run --write, then commit both. Do NOT hand-edit inside the markers. SCOPE: this file records state, it does not decide anything - it changes no release slot, no scope, no requirement and no AC. publish_gate._model: THREE DISTINCT FACTS, deliberately NOT collapsed into one word. The predecessor model carried `minted`/`signed` plus a single `state_word: "unsigned"`, and the STATUS §1 `Unblocks` view rendered its sentence off that one word — so the board told every reader `**Publish remains blocked on AC-079**, which is **still unsigned**` AFTER the HITL had PRE-SIGNED that delta on 2026-07-25 (master F-34). Restating a settled call as still open is precisely how a settled call gets re-decided. The three facts a consumer MUST read separately: (1) `pre_sign_state` - has the HITL signed off on the CONTENT of the delta yet? (2) `minted` + `sign_off_slice` - has the AC been minted into dev/acceptance.md and recorded there as SIGNED yet? PRE-SIGN IS NOT MINTING. (3) `publish_gated_by` - what actually holds publish, which is the separate HITL publish gate (`decisions.unruled` id `publish`), NOT an unsigned AC. No consumer may derive a single status word from `minted`/`signed` alone; both renderers (scripts/check-release-state-views.sh render_status_unblocks, scripts/commission-manifest.sh publish-gate line) branch on `pre_sign_state` and hard-fail on an unrecognised value or a reintroduced `state_word`.

generated_views.why_only_the_count: T2b (DOC-HYGIENE-2). The measured failure was §4 listing >=4 ALREADY-RULED items as still open, i.e. the COUNT of the live open set drifting from the single writer - which is exactly what this region pins. The surrounding sentence is NOT generated, for two reasons, both binding. (1) Its two items are worded in different shapes ('the <label> - <detail>, taken to the HITL **once**, at <gate>' vs '**<label>** (<gate>, hard gate)') and it closes on a findings citation (master F-34), so no template over the fact model reproduces it; only pasting the sentence into this JSON would, and that is the move check-release-state-views.sh explicitly refuses ('widen the fact model or NARROW THE REGION - never paste the prose into the JSON'). (2) CommonMark: a blockquote line whose content BEGINS with `<!--` is an HTML block that swallows the whole line, so a BEGIN marker cannot be placed at the head of this line without changing how it renders. Narrowing keeps the fence in place, byte-exact, and fully reversible. The full ruled/unruled table is emitted by `ledgerwatch <ledger> --project rulings`, and the ruled/unruled FACTS live in `decisions` above; §4's items 1-22 are the historical decision record and are deliberately NOT under generation.
